result.rationale: The migration inserts old `embeddable_hosts` values verbatim via raw SQL (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), bypassing the model's `before_validation` normalization (`self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` etc.). The lookup `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` compares against URI hosts, so entries like 'http://discourse.org' or 'https://example.com/1234' (which the specs show were common formats) will never match after migration, silently breaking existing embeds. The unescaped string interpolation in SQL is also visible in the diff.
